slug: 2026-02-16 Comoros - Anjouan (Ndzuani) to produce its own biometric ID cards (Genkey replaces Semlex)

systems.system: Biometric national identity card and passport production (Genkey, replacing Semlex)
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior; Genkey as contractor from April 2026
systems.tiers: Produced in Moroni until now; local printing of identity cards on Ndzuani announced on 12 February 2026

note: The document concerns local printing of biometric identity cards on Ndzuani, an identity system; it states nothing about civil registration.
